description: Cloud project management: Create a GitHub Pull Request with the latest run's translations. If the project's PR is still open (same target languages), the run is added to it instead. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

base_branch.description: Branch to open the PR against; must exist (default: the project's branch)

force_new.description: Open a new PR even if one is still open (replaces the link to it)

title.description: PR title (default names the translated languages)

name: babelize_pr_raise
title: Raise Pull Request
